name: Neural Lumigraph Rendering
aliases: Neural Radiance Fields with SDF export
definition: A neural rendering framework that jointly optimizes an implicit signed distance function (SDF) for shape and a radiance field for appearance, supervised exclusively by posed 2D images, enabling real-time export of view-dependent textured meshes.
summary: Neural Lumigraph Rendering jointly optimizes an implicit shape and radiance field from 2D images, exporting a textured mesh for real-time rasterization while maintaining high image quality.
